description: JavaScript source file implementing Bootstrap's affix plugin (version 3.3.7), which manages element positioning based on scroll position.

classes.name: Affix
classes.description: Class defining the affix behavior for sticky positioning based on scroll.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Determines the current affix state ('top', 'bottom', or false) based on scroll position and offsets.

methods.name: getPinnedOffset
methods.description: Calculates and caches the offset when the element is pinned.

methods.name: checkPositionWithEventLoop
methods.description: Schedules a position check after a brief delay.

methods.name: checkPosition
methods.description: Checks and updates the element's affix state based on current scroll position.
